Democrat Mary Peltola Wins Alaska Senate Seat

Democrat Mary Peltola has won the Alaska Senate race, securing a victory against incumbent Republican Dan Sullivan. The win gives Democrats 56 seats. Peltola's victory in the tight race was confirmed by an official count.
